sta_castle_guide.text: That's the bottle dungeon. Twenty-four feet down into solid rock. Cardinal Beaton kept prisoners there, and after he was murdered in 1546, the story goes his body was kept down there too, in salt.
Don't lean over. We've lost a lot of sunglasses.

sta_mine_digger.text: During the siege of 1546 the attackers dug a tunnel through the rock to get under the walls. The defenders heard them and dug a countermine to meet them. Both tunnels are still here.
The countermine had a few false starts before they found the mine. You can crawl through it. Mind your head. Everybody bumps their head. Even me, and I work here.
